Tests ChaCha20 RNG roll results against Rust samples and iterates a debug roll loop.

# Purpose
This file is a test and debug executable for the `fd_chacha20_rng` interface. It checks that ChaCha20-based uniform integer sampling matches reference values from Rust `rand_chacha::ChaChaRng` for both `FD_CHACHA_RNG_MODE_SHIFT` and `FD_CHACHA_RNG_MODE_MOD`. The file also contains a long-run test, [`test_iterated`](<#test_iterated>), which applies repeated rolls and verifies the final state against a known result.

The [`main`](<#main>) function first runs the built-in tests, then accepts command-line options `--range`, `--count`, and `--key` to drive a debug run of the RNG. It creates a `fd_chacha_rng_t` object, initializes it with a 32-byte key built from the input `ulong`, and calls `fd_chacha20_rng_ulong_roll` in a loop to produce debug output. The file uses `fd_boot`, `fd_halt`, and `FD_TEST`, so it is an executable that depends on the wider `fd_chacha_rng` API and related support code.
